# Preparing for the Upcoming API User Group Meeting - Dec 18th

_Category: API Meetings · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**neeraja.kumar** (12/4/2024):

Dear API User Group Members,

As we prepare for the upcoming API User Group meeting, we encourage you to share any questions or topics you would like addressed. This will allow the product owners to review your inquiries in advance and ensure they are ready with thorough responses during the session.

Please feel free to post your questions at your earliest convenience.

**iharder** (12/5/2024):

Our team needs a fully functional sandbox to move ahead with development. That includes records that are the same in the search API as in the business API, fully functional payment API (or at least one that can return fees for all types of businesses), and ideally a known list of existing companies that we can work with.

While the above will help us to successfully use the business/search/fee postman collections, 
a live or recorded training session would have a big impact so that we can see the workflow for the various API calls. The live session would be preferable as we would then have an opportunity for questions as they arise.

Finally, more comprehensive reference documentation of the APIs would be very helpful. Currently there is some documentation, but it's not complete, and we're left guessing as to whether some elements are required, what valid codes to use, etc.

Thank-you
